title: Checks that passed broken work: ledger citations, lint paths, the held-out reword gate and the query-log apply guards
goal: check.py refuses a ledger citation whose line lies past the end of its article at any distance; the sync gate runs the held-out reword check when a landing changes only a root's doc2query expansions.csv; lint.py given a kb/-prefixed article path lints it, and an argument matching no article exits non-zero naming it; apply's lead share check reads the passage pack prints, not the whole source line; the gap step's ledger guard rejects an entry and restores the ledger for any error check.py gives it, not only path:line citations; done refuses a content item whose commit advances _fetch_state.csv baselines or drops anchors of sources its goal does not name

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
